summary: Checked against the pages themselves (Yamaha, Kymco, SYM, Gogoro, 環境部, 全國法規資料庫, TVBS, udn). A buyer with nothing to scrap should not use Yamaha's NT$46,700 Jog headline. That price assumes scrapping an old scooter. Yamaha's own page shows a printed price of NT$66,000 (excluding plate insurance). Without scrapping, take off the NT$7,000 購車金 and the NT$2,000 new-purchase tax cut, which leaves NT$57,000 at most. The NT$5,000 conditional bonus may take that down to NT$52,000, so ask the dealer. All Yamaha and Kymco offers end 2026-11-30, and 2027 is unknown. Running fees: road-maintenance fee NT$450 a year for 51-125cc (official table), compulsory insurance about NT$658 a year for a 普通重型 scooter (unchanged in 2026), and a free exhaust test each year from year 5 (NT$500 fine if late). The NT$563 insurance figure is for 微型電動二輪車 (a small class), so it should not be applied to Gogoro-type scooters. No official electric-scooter premium was found. Not verified: plate fees (about NT$650, blocked), printed prices for 勁豪, Limi, Vinoora and Kymco models, 0-50 km/h, and 3-5 year resale values.

findings.subject: Yamaha Jog 125 Nov 2026 official promo arithmetic
findings.valueText: 建議售價66,000 (不含牌險). Official breakdown to 46,700 = 66,000 - 7,000 購車金 - 2,000 新購減徵 - 5,000 conditional 加碼購車金 - 1,000 汰舊加碼 - 4,000 汰舊減徵 - 300 舊車回收. The 4,000, 1,000 and 300 need scrapping. Whether the 5,000 needs scrapping is not stated.
findings.quote: 建議售價(不含牌險)66,000元-YAMAHA購車金7,000元-政府新購貨物稅減徵2,000元-符合政府貨物稅減免資格再加碼購車金5,000元-YAMAHA 40週年汰舊加碼感謝金1,000元-政府貨物稅減免4,000元-政府舊車回收300元=46,700元
findings.buyerType: 46,700 is scrap-and-replace only (page headline: 汰舊最低入手46,700元; 配合汰舊換新享40周年慶加碼).
findings.conditions: Authorised physical dealers on Taiwan main island only; online purchase not eligible. Valid 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30.
findings.verifierNote: Opened the page (curl) and the arithmetic adds up (66,000-7,000-2,000-5,000-1,000-4,000-300 = 46,700). No-scrap price derived: 57,000 (if the 5,000 is scrap-linked) or 52,000 (if granted with the 新購 tax cut); the ambiguity is genuine on the page. The page quotes 不含牌險 so plate insurance (about 658) is extra.

findings.quote: 最高補助17,300元=YAMAHA購車金7,000元+政府新購貨物稅減徵2,000元+符合政府貨物稅減免資格再加碼購車金3,000元+政府汰舊貨物稅減免4,000元+YAMAHA 40週年汰舊加碼感謝金1,000元+政府舊車回收300元

findings.verifierNote: Opened page; sum checks (17,300). The 9,000-12,000 no-scrap range is derived, not stated by Yamaha.

findings.subject: 強制險 重型機車 premium unchanged at 2026-07-01
findings.valueText: 重型機車 1 year about 658; 2 years about 1,200; unchanged while death/first-degree disability cover rises from NT$2m to NT$3m on 7月1日
findings.quote: 重型機車一年期約658元、兩年期約1,200元，這次均維持不變。
findings.verifierNote: Opened udn page. IMPORTANT correction to the electric note: the NT$563 one-year figure belongs to the 微型電動二輪車 class (the small electric two-wheeler class), not to a Gogoro or other plated electric scooter. Electric 普通輕型 / 普通重型 scooters are most likely rated as 輕型 (first sweep: 424) or 普通重型 (658), but I found no official sentence saying so. Treat electric-scooter premium as unconfirmed.
